answer.summary: Architecture test TenantActiveTableAccessArchTest.payload_identities_repository_access_is_reviewed fails deterministically. ThreatArsenalService.updateActionPayloadBased calls PayloadIdentity.getId() at ThreatArsenalService.java:313, which violates the allowed-package rule. The PR touches ThreatArsenalService.java, and the test has no flake history, so a rerun will likely fail the same way. The fix is to move that call inside an allowed class or update the rule if the access is intended.
